overrides.reason: 2026-09-25 user request removes digital avatar creation and all follow-up states 07–24
overrides.decision: Step denominator 4 → 3; final save completes onboarding and opens the app; avatar-related Figma frames and app goldens removed.

overrides.reason: 2026-09-25 user decision: loading and retry should reuse general product feedback rather than onboarding-specific design frames
overrides.decision: No onboarding-specific Figma screens or golden snapshots. Figma frames 01–02 were deleted and verified in a fresh tab on 2026-09-25. Runtime uses shared ProductLoadingView and ProductErrorView (retry).

overrides.reason: 2026-09-25 user clarification: delivery count includes the current birth; cesarean history refers only to births before it
overrides.decision: Ask for the numbered delivery on step 1. Only show the previous-cesarean question when deliveryCount > 1; first delivery persists false without asking. The 390px repeat-delivery variant remains a separate local screenshot. The four visible Figma frames 03–06 now display the updated 390×844 three-step images; old embedded four-step screenshots were hidden. This is an image-layer sync, not an independent pixel-parity or complete profile-field audit.

overrides.reason: 2026-09-26 user noticed that gestational weeks and days were omitted from the three-step onboarding screenshots; current feeding method was also missing.
overrides.decision: Step 2 collects delivery date plus gestational weeks (20–45) and additional days (0–6, including explicit zero). Step 3 collects current feeding method with an explicit Not sure yet option. App and local Backend now validate and persist both; Figma frames 04–06 use new 390×844 App screenshots. Older v2 image layers are hidden. No independent Figma pixel export or online App/Backend release is claimed.

overrides.reason: 2026-09-26 user feedback: align gestational weeks/days inputs and explicitly identify the current delivery in steps 2 and 3.
overrides.decision: The two gestation text fields share top/bottom alignment even when their labels wrap. Step titles and date, weeks, delivery method, and baby-count copy clarify that they refer to this delivery. Refresh 390×844 reference bitmaps; no workflow or data-contract changes.

overrides.reason: 2026-09-27 product decision: enable onboarding by default on a fresh user dataset and unify onboarding + Me feeding as multi-select.
overrides.decision: Replace step-3 single select with four feeding chips matching Me. Persist one canonical feeding_methods list, derive maternal/current-baby mode; release reset stays off. Figma frames 05–06 use refreshed 390×844 App screenshot layers after independently reopened visual verification; no old-account migration or data purge performed.
